Extra Charge / Rapid Recharge gives Powder Keg the charges to chain combos, and Echo Shard double-casts Spirit Lasso so the pick window never closes. The guide's own tip is this combo: Bounce Pad in, Keg on the landing spot, stomp-detonate, drag the survivor into the blast with Spirit Lasso.
